message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815, resulted in roughly **47,000 total casualties**—the sum of killed, wounded, and missing on both sides.

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition (Wellington & Blücher) | ~22,000 |

These figures come from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses. While exact numbers vary slightly among sources, most historians agree that the combined toll was close to half‑a‑million soldiers affected when you include non‑combatant losses and logistical casualties.
